Quantum 1.15.0 was certified on 2026-08-25. It pins **nucleus v1.11.0**, **quark v1.6.0** and **orbit v1.6.6**, with 5 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.14.0: nucleus goes from v1.10.0 to v1.11.0 (minor), quark goes from v1.5.2 to v1.6.0 (minor) and orbit goes from v1.6.5 to v1.6.6 (patch). 4 sibling modules change version.
